name: browser-use
headline: WeChat Article Formatter - Format Markdown for
short_description: This skill converts markdown files into styled HTML optimized for WeChat public account articles. It uses the bm.md rendering service and supports automatic local image uploads. Ideal for operations teams managing WeChat content.
author: iamzifei

sections.overview:
The WeChat Article Formatter Skill converts markdown files into beautifully styled HTML specifically optimized for WeChat public account articles. It automatically detects local images referenced in markdown, uploads them to online hosting, and replaces file paths with shareable URLs. The skill applies custom CSS styling with a green accent color theme, supports GitHub Flavored Markdown syntax, includes code highlighting, and enables footnote link conversion. This is ideal for content operations teams who manage WeChat public accounts and need to quickly format and publish articles without manual HTML editing.
Format blog posts and articles for WeChat public accounts with consistent styling
Automatically upload and replace local images in markdown with online URLs
Batch convert markdown documentation to WeChat-compatible HTML
Prepare styled articles for draft publishing to WeChat with integrated publisher skill
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/iamzifei/wechat-article-formatter-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Convert this markdown file into a WeChat-optimized HTML article. The markdown content is: [MARKDOWN_CONTENT]. Upload all images locally and ensure the output is compatible with WeChat's public account platform. The target audience is [TARGET_AUDIENCE] in the [INDUSTRY] industry.
```
